raw_text: Anti-CAA protests paralysed life across Northeast India on Tuesday as a coordinated bandh shut down road and rail networks in Assam, Tripura, and Meghalaya. Protest organizers used Telegram groups to coordinate bandh calls, share routes, and issue instructions for disrupting transport infrastructure. Security forces were deployed in large numbers as clashes were reported at multiple locations in Guwahati.
